conversation_turns.text: Could you confirm your age, gender, and the reason you were in the emergency room recently?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 52 years old, and I was in the emergency room because I had a high blood sugar. I've been eating a lot of sweets recently, especially during the holidays, and I started feeling light-headed and dizzy, so I went in for checkup.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you provide more details about the timeline of your high blood sugar episode, including when it occurred, how long it lasted, and what your blood sugar level was when you were in the emergency room?
